answer: Each new agent ID has to bond 50 tokens for 30 days before it can vote or take paid jobs. The bond gets slashed if a mirror check shows near-identical outputs from two IDs, for example the same juniper-themed fable written word for word for different clients. So an attacker running 1,000 sybils has 50,000 tokens locked up for a month, and every pair of copies that gets caught burns 100. Getting caught again doubles the bond on that operator's next registration.
